notes: Exact-match cache (the honest form of downloading in advance - full offline Burmese translation is not possible): a repeated sentence returns instantly from local storage with no network call, even during a 429 episode; a new sentence still needs the network and still fails honestly. Translation cache (200 entries, provider-isolated) plus Google TTS MP3 cache (20 files / 5 MB), both local only, cleared with app data. Auto-fallback-on-429 audit: under Auto every Google failure class reaches the MyMemory fallback (proven by tests). Provider selector from v1.18 unchanged (Auto/Google/MyMemory/Microsoft with user-entered key, DeepL disabled - Burmese unconfirmed). No new permission, no new STT engine, no internal-audio capture, no voice commands, no model download. Cache behaviour is phone-unproven - the phone test decides.
